title: Rust WebRTC sidecar MVP
description: Track the NanoKVM Rust WebRTC sidecar rollout: backend selection at boot, rust-only startup path, packaging, and validation.

title: Branch/devshell setup and Rust toolchain additions
description: Add and validate the NanoKVM flake/devshell support for the Rust sidecar, including pinned Rust tooling, target triples, cargo-nextest, rust-analyzer, clang/bindgen, and the build plumbing needed for the sidecar and server binaries.

title: Rust signaling compatibility
description: Keep the Rust sidecar wire-compatible with the existing frontend signaling contract: ice-servers, video-offer, video-answer, video-candidate, and heartbeat.

title: Rust hardware capture binding to libkvm
description: Bind the Rust sidecar to libkvm/kvm_vision.h on the RISC-V target, matching ReadH264(width, height, bitrate) semantics and handling resource cleanup safely.

title: RTP/WebRTC media pipeline
description: Implement the Rust RTP path for H.264 frame packetization, playout-delay extension handling, ICE/STUN/TURN parity, and RTCP drain behavior.

title: Go authenticated WebSocket proxy
description: Keep /api/stream/h264 behind middleware.CheckToken() and proxy the upgraded WebSocket to the local Rust sidecar when the rust backend is selected.

title: Target packaging and service startup
description: Package the Rust sidecar alongside the server binaries and make the init/startup path choose rust or legacy backend at boot.

title: Hardware validation and rollback notes
description: Validate the rust backend on device, confirm reconnect and stop behavior, and document a rollback path back to the legacy Go/Pion binary if the MVP misbehaves.
